description:
Search open jobs across all indexed career sites (duplicates merged). Use
        list_filter_values for valid filter values and get_job for a job's full description.

        Returns `jobs` (id, title, company, location, remote, employment_type, salary text and
        `salary_range` with numeric min, max, currency, period and yearly_min/yearly_max (null
        without a stated period: such amounts are not comparable), posted_at, first_seen_at, url,
        company_url, apply_url) newest or most relevant first, `next_cursor` and `complete`
        (false: the search ran out of time and `jobs` holds only what was found in time, title
        and company matches or nothing; retry or narrow the filters). For the next page repeat
        the call with the same filters and `cursor` set to `next_cursor`; null means the last
        page.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous call with the same filters.
cursor.title: Cursor

employment_type.description: Employment type; see list_filter_values for counts.

has_salary.description: Only jobs whose posting states a salary.
has_salary.title: Has Salary

limit.description: Jobs per page, 1-50 (1-25 without an API key).
limit.title: Limit

location.description: Matches city, region or country text of the job location, e.g. `Berlin` or `Germany`.
location.title: Location

min_salary.description: Only jobs whose posted salary range reaches this yearly amount in `salary_currency` (USD unless given), e.g. 180000. Hourly, daily, weekly and monthly pay is converted to a year; a salary without a stated period never matches.
min_salary.title: Min Salary

posted_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone; jobs posted or first seen after it.
posted_after.title: Posted After

q.description: Full-text query in web search syntax: "quoted phrases", OR, -exclude and (parentheses). `-word` excludes it from the whole query, or from the parentheses it stands in. Omit to list the newest jobs.
q.title: Q

remote.description: Work mode as stated by the employer, or `unknown` for jobs that state none (about two in three); see list_filter_values for counts.
remote.title: Remote

salary_currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as `EUR`; only jobs with a salary in it.
salary_currency.title: Salary Currency

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
